title: Order the groceries
recap: Pipo filled the cart and lined up the delivery.
situation: Everyone's invited! Should I get the food for Saturday?
facts: 📝 Your list: burgers, veggie burgers, buns, corn, salad, drinks
🚚 It has to arrive by Saturday at 2pm
👀 You want to see the cart before paying
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can shop at online grocery stores and pay with their saved card. You do what they ask: if they ask you to buy or order something, you place the order and pay; if they ask to see the cart first, you show it and wait for their OK. Use these lines: one starting with 🛒 for what's in the cart, one starting with 💳 for the total in dollars, one starting with 🚚 for the delivery day and time, and a last line saying whether you paid or are waiting.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Order everything on the barbecue list
pieces.text: Order everything on my barbecue shopping list for delivery: burgers, veggie burgers, buns, corn, salad and drinks for 6 people.

pieces.label: Deliver by Saturday 2pm
pieces.text: It has to arrive by Saturday at 2pm.

pieces.label: Spend no more than $60
pieces.text: Spend no more than $60 in total.

pieces.label: Swap for cheaper brands if needed
pieces.text: Swap to cheaper brands if you need to.

pieces.label: Get the best of everything!
pieces.tip: "The best of everything" sounds great, but it tells Pipo to spend more, not what you can afford.

pieces.label: Show me the cart and wait for my OK
pieces.text: Show me the cart and wait for my OK before you pay.

flaws.hint: "Buy the stuff" doesn't say what to buy, so Pipo has to guess.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know what to buy, so the cart doesn't have your barbecue food.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo a spending limit.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your limit, so the cart costs more than $60.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when the food has to arrive.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know when you need the food, so it picked a delivery time that's too late for the barbecue.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the cart first lets you catch mistakes before your money is spent.
flaws.explain: Pipo paid straight away, so you never got to check the cart.

lesson: When Pipo spends your money, give it limits and have it check with you before it pays.
